maxillary_keypoint_topology.keypoint_spatial_matrix: The four keypoints in the superior row are arranged in a slightly ascending arc, positioned at a vertical distance of approximately 1.5 spot-widths from the denser secondary row immediately below.

rhinarium_pixel_ratio.melanin_saturation_percentage: The rhinarium exhibits high melanin saturation of approximately 90%, with minor pale/pink pixel clusters confined to the lower edges of the philtrum and ventral nostril margins.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible cluster of dark, localized scabs or healing puncture wounds on the left buccal region; a slight notch is present on the superior-medial margin of the left ear pinna.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent black patches on the posterior side of both ears and a distinct dark stripe (tear mark) extending from the medial canthus of the eye toward the muzzle.
